summary: Tested Welcome Popup behavior on homepage. Most features work correctly, but found 1 bug: clicking 'Client' button navigates to '/checkin' instead of staying on homepage '/'.

ui_bugs.issue: After new user enters name and clicks 'Client', the app navigates to '/checkin' instead of staying on homepage '/'
ui_bugs.current_behavior: navigate('/checkin') is called after successful user registration
ui_bugs.expected_behavior: User should stay on homepage '/' after clicking Client button

action_items: Fix WelcomePopup onSubmit callback (line 1147) to NOT navigate to '/checkin' - user should stay on homepage '/' after clicking Client button
critical_code_review_comments: Line 1147 in LinkTreeHomePage.jsx: The onSubmit callback navigates to '/checkin' after user registration, but requirements state user should stay on homepage '/'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome Popup testing completed. The 'Check In !' button on homepage correctly navigates to /social/{location} when user has valid profile AND saved location. The SocialWallPage validates profile exists in database before allowing access.

welcome_popup_geolocation_denied.test: When geolocation is denied, popup shows 'Find Your Location' prompt with scrollable location list (no default location)
welcome_popup_geolocation_denied.details: 8 location buttons visible, no 'You're near' section shown

new_user_location_select.test: New user clicking a location in popup saves it to localStorage and closes popup, staying on '/'
new_user_location_select.details: Location saved as 'edgewood-atlanta', popup closed, stayed on homepage

new_user_login_signup.test: New user clicking 'Log In / Sign Up' navigates to '/account'

new_user_client_button.test: New user entering name + clicking 'Client' saves info and closes popup, staying on '/'
new_user_client_button.details: User info saved correctly, but navigated to '/checkin' instead of staying on homepage '/'
new_user_client_button.bug_location: LinkTreeHomePage.jsx line 1147: navigate('/checkin') should be removed

returning_user_popup.test: Returning user popup shows 'Find Your Location' prompt (no default) and location list
returning_user_popup.details: Simplified view shown with location list, no name input or Client/Staff buttons

returning_user_location_select.test: Returning user selecting a location saves it and closes popup, staying on '/'
returning_user_location_select.details: Location saved as 'douglasville', popup closed, stayed on homepage

homepage_checkin_button_no_profile.test: Homepage button shows 'My Account' and goes to '/account' when user has no profile

homepage_checkin_button_with_profile.test: Homepage 'Check In !' button navigates to '/social/{location}' when user has profile and saved location
homepage_checkin_button_with_profile.details: Button shows 'Check In !', navigates to /social/{location}. SocialWallPage validates profile exists in database - if profile doesn't exist, redirects to /account. This is expected behavior.

localStorage_keys_tested.ff_welcome_shown: Set to 'true' when user completes welcome flow (marks returning user)
localStorage_keys_tested.ff_welcome_shown_session: Set in sessionStorage to prevent popup from showing again in same session
localStorage_keys_tested.ff_user_profile_id: Stores user profile ID after registration
localStorage_keys_tested.ff_user_info: Stores user info JSON (name, role, etc.)
